integrity: The structural criterion is proved directly from simultaneous two-attack defense in a multipartite graph. The coefficient formula follows from an exact description of bad heavy-part events. A separate definition-level checker tests all attack pairs and defender pairs on every multipartite isomorphism type through order ten.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is restricted to connected complete multipartite graphs.
Secure 2-domination from the 2022 literature is a different invariant and is not covered.
Finite exhaustive verification through order ten is corroborative only.
Search coverage cannot exclude differently phrased or non-indexed prior enumerative work.
title: All 2-secure dominating sets of complete multipartite graphs
